#Install binaries from Bioconductor version 3.16. See tutorial DAADA2 Installation and dada2 tutorial

Install BiocManager

#if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
#    install.packages("BiocManager")

Install DADA2

#BiocManager::install("dada2")

Load the DADA2 library


library(dada2); packageVersion("dada2")
[1] ‘1.34.0’
getwd()
[1] "/home/brymoore/wsg_gtdb_tax/pig_microbiome/PRJEB8696"

Set the path to fastq files

path <- "/home/brymoore/wsg_gtdb_tax/pig_microbiome/PRJEB8696/fastq_files" #Change me to the directory containing the fastq files(unzipped)

list.files(path)

# In side of the folder containing my fastq files
# Forward and reverse fastq.gz filenames have format: SAMPLENAME_1.fastq.gz and SAMPLENAME_2.fastq.gz
fnFs <- sort(list.files(path, pattern="_1.fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE))
fnRs <- sort(list.files(path, pattern="_2.fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE))
# Extract sample names, assuming filenames have format: SAMPLENAME_XXX.fastq.gz
sample.names <- sapply(strsplit(basename(fnFs), "_"), `[`, 1)
sample.names

Filter and Trim

Assign the filenames for the filtered fastq.gz files.

# Place filtered files in filtered/ subdirectory
filtFs <- file.path(path, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_F_filt.fastq.gz"))
filtRs <- file.path(path, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_R_filt.fastq.gz"))
names(filtFs) <- sample.names
names(filtRs) <- sample.names
out <- filterAndTrim(fnFs, filtFs, fnRs, filtRs, truncLen=c(290,280),
              maxN=0, maxEE=c(2,5), truncQ=2, rm.phix=TRUE,
              compress=TRUE, multithread=TRUE) # On Windows set multithread=FALSE (only needed for filterAndTrim)

Learn Error Rates

errF <- learnErrors(filtFs, multithread=TRUE)
167253730 total bases in 576737 reads from 1 samples will be used for learning the error rates.
errR <- learnErrors(filtRs, multithread=TRUE)
161486360 total bases in 576737 reads from 1 samples will be used for learning the error rates.
plotErrors(errF, nominalQ=TRUE)

plotErrors(errR, nominalQ=TRUE)

Sample Inference

dadaFs <- dada(filtFs, err=errF, multithread=TRUE)
